---
name: "⚙️ Improvement"
about: Describe an optimization or refactor you are going to work on
title: "[Improvement]: "
labels: ["improvement"]
---

### 🎯 Objective

What are you improving (performance, maintainability, DX, etc.)?

### 🧠 Context

Why is this improvement necessary?  
Mention pain points, bottlenecks, or technical debt being addressed.

### 🔧 Approach

Outline how you intend to approach this — refactor plan, technology changes, etc.

### 🧪 Validation

How will you verify that the improvement worked (metrics, tests, benchmarks)?

### ✅ Checklist

- [ ] Code changes complete
- [ ] Tests cover new behavior
- [ ] Verified performance or quality improvements
